description: This Java source file defines the CriteriaQueryFactory class, which provides utility methods for constructing and executing JPA criteria queries with support for sorting, pagination, and specifications within a Fineract project.

classes.name: CriteriaQueryFactory
classes.description: A Spring component class that encapsulates logic for constructing JPA criteria queries with support for sorting, pagination, and specifications.

methods.name: ordersFromPageable
methods.description: Generates a list of JPA Orders based on the Pageable's sort information, with optional default order.

methods.name: readPage
methods.description: Executes a paged query and returns a Page object with results and total count.

methods.name: executeCountQuery
methods.description: Executes a count query to determine the total number of entities matching the specification.

methods.name: getCountQuery
methods.description: Builds a count query based on the provided specification and domain class.

methods.name: applySpecificationToCriteria
methods.description: Applies a Specification's predicate to a CriteriaQuery.
